deviations.what: c15 S8.2 *Report viewer · Profit and Loss*: the frame's header is a left-aligned title over a muted subtitle 'Sharma Textile · Aug 2026' (book · period) with two outlined square buttons 'PDF' and 'Share' at the right (c15 *Trial Balance* / *You will get, by age* / *Family match check*: bold title, subtitle 'Sharma Textile · as at 31 Aug 2026', navy text links 'PDF' 'Share', no back chevron); the app's bar has a chevron, 'Day Book' as title with no subtitle, a navy share icon + 'Download / Share' text button and a ••• overflow icon for Choose a format
deviations.reason: [shared] app bar (title + book · period subtitle, leading alignment, text actions); the two actions stay as ruled — Download/Share sends PDF, Choose a format opens the three-format sheet — the frame's 'PDF' + 'Share' pair is a relabel the owner may rule on
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-09-12 §1 🔒 (View report / Download-Share, both paths); ADR 2026-09-12d §2 🔒 (PDF default); ADR 2026-09-13 §1 🔒 (Share half)

deviations.what: c15 S8.2 *Report viewer · Profit and Loss*: the frame has a one-line takeaway band on paper ('August: in ₹1,75,000 · out ₹1,38,200 · saved ₹36,800') then an uppercase letter-spaced column header (KHATA · THIS MONTH · YEAR) with a heavy rule under it; the Day Book shows 'FY 2026-27' as muted text, a takeaway line '7 entries ₹1,65,000 Dr ₹1,65,000 Cr', a green check + 'Dr and Cr agree', and a sentence-case 'Particulars   Dr   Cr' header at title size with no rule
deviations.reason: [shared] report table header (uppercase caption, heavy rule) and takeaway band; FY as plain text is the ruled shipped state until a year has closed
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-09-09 §4 🔒 (FY switcher: plain text before any close); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: c15 S8.2 *Report viewer · Profit and Loss* / *Trial Balance*: rows are single-line label + right-aligned figures split by hairlines; the Day Book groups each voucher as a block — date heading (muted, title size), one row per line with the Dr figure in the middle column and the Cr in the right, the narration muted under, and a full-bleed hairline between vouchers
deviations.reason: [screen] — the Day Book's voucher grouping is its own shape (07 §14); row type and density follow the frame's table rows when restyled — [shared] list row (report row)

deviations.what: While Download / Share (or a format picked from the sheet) writes the file, a 2 px loader rule with 'Preparing your file' sits under the app bar, and further taps are ignored until the file is written. No canvas frame draws this transient state; it is not in any capture, because the drawn states are idle
deviations.reason: [state] — the canvas draws no export-in-progress frame; this follows S4's generating rule for the same export (s4_account_statement_screen.dart _GeneratingRule). Added after shaping made a Punjabi or Hindi PDF take long enough to need it (REP183C review finding 4)
